**Finding: MFN — compliant (preferred position met); no redline proposed.**

- **Fee/pricing provisions (Sections 3.1–3.4)** contain only a fixed revenue share (30% of Net Sales above $11,000/month) plus payment, quarterly reconciliation and inspection mechanics — no obligation on the Company to give HDI best or most-favourable terms, to match a third-party offer, or to disclose terms granted to others.
- **Section 1.8** is the only "no less favorabl[e]" comparison in the document and it runs **in our favour** (HDI must promote the Site and Deerskin Products no less favourably than its own catalog titles), so it is not flagged.
- **Section 6 (Exclusivity)** restricts the Company's online use of the "Deerskin" brand, but that is an exclusivity term, not an MFN/right-to-match mechanic; per the boundary rules it is not flagged a second time under MFN.
- Searches for MFN, "most favored/favourable", "no less favorable", and right-to-match language returned no Customer-burdening hits across all sections.
